verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents running unmodified Node.js code or arbitrary npm packages inside Workers functions. Community users say Workers lacks a full Node runtime, which keeps them on Vercel or Netlify. Containers ('any runtime') is a separate product rather than the Workers function runtime itself, so it is adjacent and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
